VICKIE BENSON.name: Vickie H. W. Benson
VICKIE BENSON.background: Educator born in Tuskegee, Ala.; bachelor's (1991) and graduate (2008) degrees from Alabama State University and a doctorate in Educational Leadership K-12 from Argosy University Atlanta; medical assistant certificate from UAB; formerly a lab technician and medical assistant.
